principal_obligations.name: ConditionalCriterion.compose_input_correct
principal_obligations.statement: Compose an actual input Circuit with scalarCircuit; its output agrees with the genuine matrix-power contraction under explicit input semantics, and its gate count includes every input Circuit gate.

principal_obligations.name: ConditionalCriterion.polynomial_composed_budget
principal_obligations.statement: For r>=1,n>=2,r<=n^d and input gates<=S<=n^c, the actual composed Circuit gate count is bounded by eval n of a constructed Polynomial Nat Pi(c,d).

metric: Number of clean kernel-verified principal obligations divided by 2; supporting declarations must use only standard Lean axioms. Helpers do not change the denominator.
scope: Conditional scalar gate criterion only. Target representation, uniform constructor running time, rational-literal bit lengths, and admissibility of parameter/rational input leaves remain additional obligations.
